prompt: What are the lyrics to the popular, unofficial fight song of the university that the main character of Gilmore Girls attended?
answer:
Rory Gilmore attended **Yale University**, whose popular unofficial fight song is **“Boola Boola.”** A commonly sung version is:

> There’s a name that is known  
> To the world far and wide,  
> And that name is old Yale,  
> And that name is old Yale.  
>   
> And wherever we go,  
> We will sing of her fame,  
> And the name of old Yale,  
> And the name of old Yale.  
>   
> **Boola Boola, Boola Boola,**  
> **Boola Boola, Boola Boola,**  
> **Boola Boola, Boola Boola,**  
> **Yale, Yale, Yale!**

Versions and repetitions can vary.
